europe.label: Europa
europe.summary: Noise pollution continues to pose significant threats to public health across Europe, as highlighted by reporting from Il Sole 24 Ore, while residents near data centres in Slough are raising concerns about the health impacts of noise from this rapidly expanding infrastructure sector. Meanwhile, traffic noise levels have reportedly decreased noticeably in some areas, suggesting that certain noise mitigation measures may be yielding positive results.

science.label: Wissenschaft
science.summary: Research into road noise prevention materials highlights a growing industry projected to reach $0.44 billion, while the acoustic camera market is forecast to expand dramatically to USD 190.81 billion by 2031. Ongoing research and discussion surrounding the limitation of sound levels and low-frequency noise further underscores the increasing scientific and regulatory attention being directed toward acoustics and noise control.
